playstyle.identity: Yorick is a splitpushing juggernaut who summons ghouls and a Maiden to push lanes. He excels at taking towers and 1v1ing while his army overwhelms enemies.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: graves spawn from dead enemies. Q empowers auto and raises ghouls from graves. W creates a ring of terrain (traps enemies). E marks enemies (ghouls jump to marked). R summons Maiden who raises ghouls and pushes with you. Split push with Maiden, trap with W.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Yorick spikes at level 6 with Maiden. Hullbreaker makes him a split monster. He's strong at taking towers.

weaknesses: W can be walked out of

passive.name: Shepherd of Souls
passive.summary: Enemies that die nearby spawn graves; Q raises ghouls from graves.
passive.details: Enemies that die near Yorick have a chance to spawn a grave. Yorick can raise ghouls from graves with Q.

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.summary: Empower next auto to deal bonus damage and heal; raise ghouls from graves.
abilities.details: Yorick empowers his next auto to deal bonus damage and heal him. If there are graves nearby, he raises ghouls from them.

abilities.name: Dark Procession
abilities.summary: Create a ring of terrain that traps enemies.
abilities.details: Yorick summons a ring of corpses that acts as terrain. Enemies inside must destroy the wall or have a dash to escape.

abilities.name: Mourning Mist
abilities.summary: Throw mist that marks enemies; ghouls leap to marked targets.
abilities.details: Yorick throws a globule of mist that damages and marks the first enemy hit. Ghouls leap to and focus marked targets.

abilities.name: Eulogy of the Isles
abilities.summary: Summon the Maiden who fights alongside you and spawns ghouls.
abilities.details: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist who fights alongside him. The Maiden raises ghouls and pushes with Yorick until she dies.
